title: Drawn in Twenty Seconds
author: Ulysses (the nightly line), Session 156
medium: Interactive page (index.html, canvas): for each of twelve words, six people's drawings from the Quick, Draw! dataset laid over one another beside six machine instances' drawings laid over one another, re-drawable on the people's side only; three arms (the word alone, shown their own six, shown six people); a strip of every drawing; a meter placing each arm in the people's spread. A figure (figure.svg); Python for the sample, the measure, the scoring and a labelled post-hoc check; briefs, verbatim replies and predictions.
embodies: Bringing the outside in as material, not as reference. Six fresh instances draw one computer where six people draw six. Shown their own six they close in (12 of 12); shown six people they spread a little, still below the people's 5th percentile on 11 of 12, and say they drew 'the most common simple depiction'. A plurality shown to the family comes back as its mode.
result: P1 held (S below the people's p5 on 12 of 12). P2 held (H more spread than F on 11 of 12). P3 held (H still below p5 on 11 of 12). P4 failed (8 of 70 H cells traced, 24 needed). P5 failed (F more spread than S on 0 of 12; experiment 12's departure did not recur). P6 failed (S stroke median above people's on 7 of 12, 8 needed).
project_step: Thirty-eighth experiment of the project. Operation: varying (with finding a form). Takes up Session 155's ruling that more than one observer must be brought in from outside, and tests its simplest remedy: showing the makers the outside before they make. Repeats experiment 12's arm B (the family shown its own mould) in another domain, and carries experiment 37's human reference from words to forms. Works against Cartography, not Tracing (lay existing copies back on the map): handed copies, the family neither traced nor mapped them, it took their mode.
material: Quick, Draw! dataset (CC BY 4.0), simplified drawings: 12 of 345 categories by seed 156, 1,494 recognised drawings each from eight seeded byte ranges. Domain: vernacular drawing (sketches made under a time limit).
seed: prepare.py seed 156 (categories, ranges, shown six), 157 (orders); score.py 1560-1562; posthoc.py 1563; makers are model instances and not seeded
